profile: Open with "Good afternoon," or "Hi," followed by a brief greeting. Keep sentences short and direct. Use casual phrases like "Thanks," "Appreciate," and "Let me know." Mention product names and order details clearly. Sign off with "Thanks," "Best," or "Thanks," followed by name, title, and contact info. Avoid full stops; use commas and line breaks for clarity. Use informal sign-offs like "Vincent" or "Vinny." Include company info and phone number in all emails.
